npcs.name: Mother Elen Bright
npcs.description: Temple Priestess associated with the Temple of Kindled Mercy.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a temple priestess and someone will point you to Mother at the Temple of Kindled Mercy. At 56, this Human has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Mother lights a candle for strangers before asking their names, and is rarely without prayer beads worn smooth on one side. Leads temple; suspicious of Quen; mentors Pola. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to keep the alms kitchen open through winter. What keeps them careful is faith becoming a weapon in council politics. To a DM, Mother is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Received an anonymous donation of black candles and a warning about 'tower fire'.

npcs.name: Brother Caldus
npcs.description: Temple Archivist associated with the temple archive loft.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a temple archivist and someone will point you to Brother at the temple archive loft. At 41, this Human has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Brother indexes sins as carefully as saints, and is rarely without key to a cabinet labeled 'disputed miracles'. Reports to Elen; rivals Quen; uses Finn sometimes. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to prove Magister Quen's work endangers souls. What keeps them careful is magic without doctrine. To a DM, Brother is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Copied a page from a restricted folio that matches Quen's latest purchase order.

npcs.name: Sister Pola
npcs.description: Alms Keeper associated with the alms yard.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a alms keeper and someone will point you to Sister at the alms yard. At 34, this Halfling has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Sister remembers every hungry face by stew preference, and is rarely without ladle polished brighter than the altar plate. Trained by Elen; feeds Mouse when he looks starved. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to start a skills school for street children. What keeps them careful is running out of barley before Midwinter. To a DM, Sister is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. A 'beggar' with soft hands asked questions about temple vault schedules.

npcs.description: Funeral Priest associated with the graveyard chapel.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a funeral priest and someone will point you to Father at the graveyard chapel. At 102, this Dwarf has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Father speaks to headstones as neighbors, and is rarely without stone chisel blessed for names. Works with Mol Deeprow; quiet observer of nobles. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to finish the memorial wall for flood victims. What keeps them careful is unmarked graves becoming a fashion for the wealthy. To a DM, Father is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Paid extra to bury a 'nobody' whose boots were Vale-cobbled.

npcs.name: Ren Candlemark
npcs.description: Acolyte associated with bell tower and candle niches.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a acolyte and someone will point you to Ren at bell tower and candle niches. At 18, this Human has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Ren practices sermons to empty pews, and is rarely without taper box with one lucky stub. Earnest junior under Elen and Caldus. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to be trusted to hold the dawn service alone. What keeps them careful is failing his vows by gossiping. To a DM, Ren is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Saw Brother Caldus meet a cloaked figure behind the charnel hedge.

npcs.name: Ivra Glass-Eye
npcs.description: Oracle associated with a rented room above the candle shop.
npcs.biography: Ivra Glass-Eye works as a oracle out of a rented room above the candle shop, a 39-year-old Tiefling with more town memory than most council minutes. Ivra covers her glass eye when the visions itch, and is rarely without bowl of river stones for casting. Controversial; Rold rents her the room; Elen half-believes her. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to warn the town of a real fire before it happens. What keeps them careful is being used as a party trick by nobles. To a DM, Ivra is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Predicted 'iron in grain and blood in cloaks' a week before Mira's stool seven mystery.

npcs.name: Sol Quietstep
npcs.description: Cloister Monk associated with the cloister herb garden.
npcs.biography: Most days begin the same for Sol Quietstep: a 44-year-old Human cloister monk moving through the cloister herb garden as if the stones themselves keep appointments with them. Sol answers questions with another hour of weeding, and is rarely without kneeling pad stuffed with lavender. Shares garden knowledge with Yara; peaceful counterweight to Caldus. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to teach silence as a craft, not a punishment. What keeps them careful is violence entering sacred quiet. To a DM, Sol is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Found chalk sigils under the cloister bench matching Nym's survey marks.

npcs.name: Chaplain Dorr
npcs.description: Guard Chaplain associated with the barracks shrine nook.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a guard chaplain and someone will point you to Chaplain at the barracks shrine nook. At 37, this Half-Orc has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Chaplain sits with shaking guards until their hands still, and is rarely without portable altar cloth stained with polish oil. Chaplain to Serra's guards. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to keep Serra's watch human when the case hardens. What keeps them careful is blessing a raid that kills the wrong people. To a DM, Chaplain is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Heard Dorn admit he almost killed Bask—and wants penance, not praise.
